content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I recently obtained a [product_name] [article_no] and I'm having issues uploading my web server to it. I used the 'Deploy to SD card' feature to transfer the file onto the SD card and enabled the web server access in the [product_name] settings. After reinserting the SD card, when I click the 'Upload' button to transfer the project, I encounter the error: 'Upload Failed! SD Card file system not found.' I would appreciate some help with this. Thank you!

The error 'Upload Failed! SD Card file system not found' typically occurs when the SD card has an incorrect file system format. Ensure that your SD card is formatted using FAT32 and does not exceed 32 GB in size. Use the slow, complete formatting option rather than fast formatting.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report difficulties and errors when trying to upload projects to a [product_name] using an SD card, primarily due to improper SD card formatting. The error message helps identify that incorrect file system formatting is the root cause, suggesting a need for clearer setup instructions or system validation of SD card format.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a seamless upload experience when following the documentation, with explicit guidance or warnings regarding SD card formatting requirements beforehand.
